readme: Google 検索ステータス ダッシュボード（https://status.search.google.com/）の告知の履歴。pnpm search-status で incidents.json を取得して id ごとに追記・上書きする（ダッシュボードは約1年分しか返さないため、消えた分もここに残す）。手で編集しない。測定窓との重なりの扱いは CLAUDE.md §5.0.2 ルール6。

incidents.title: November 2026 core update
incidents.firstText: Released the November 2026 core update <https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/core-updates>, which applies globally and to all languages. The rollout may take up to 2 weeks to complete.

incidents.title: February 2026 Discover update
incidents.firstText: Released the February 2026 Discover core update <https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2026/02/discover-core-update> for English language users in the US (will look to expand it to all countries and languages in the future). This update is designed to improve the quality of Discover overall. Our guidance about general core updates <https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/core-updates> and Discover <https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-discover> applies. The rollout may take up to 2 weeks to complete.
